summary: Paper Grand Prix is a hand-drawn 3-lap race on lined paper where your red No. 5 car battles the blue No. 8 around an oval for the gold trophy at track centre. Drive with Arrows/WASD, hold Space to spend ink painting a red boost road behind you and release it on your fresh ink to launch ahead — grab markers to refill, thread the pylon gate for sparkles, and finish three laps first to win.
